locator.title: Рейс на Курорт Красная Поляна задержали. Что делать?
locator.lead: Разбираем гарантии по каждой ситуации и 4 способа получить помощь на месте

nearest_text_before.text: Они действуют для любых открытых тарифов, включая акции и спецпредложения. Единственное исключение: скидки на проживание, SPA или рестораны, полученные по этим гарантиям, не суммируются с другими скидками — по акциям или спецпредложениям.

nearest_text_after.text: Мы делаем всё, чтобы ваш отпуск состоялся и принёс долгожданную радость — что бы ни происходило с расписанием самолетов.

image_reading: Hotel reception scene with a couple, a bell attendant, a receptionist, a suitcase, and visible travel documents at the counter.
The guests appear calm and welcomed; the reception desk is the clear focal point.
analysis.article_context: Closing body image: guests with luggage present travel documents at the resort reception, supporting the article’s promise that flight-disruption evidence can be handled on site and the holiday can still begin calmly.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The resort can calmly acknowledge travelers’ flight-related documents and help the planned holiday continue.
structured_intent.primary_action: The receptionist gives the arriving guests a reassuring acknowledgment.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The receptionist has completed a clear reassuring nod toward the guests at the desk.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The guests remain welcomed, calm, and supported despite the disrupted journey.

models.scene_plan: Across five seconds, the receptionist’s attention settles on the arriving couple and she makes one small, unhurried reassuring nod. The guests keep their relaxed stance and the document stays visible at the desk. Fixed camera preserves the reception interaction; the nod reaches its completed, welcoming position near the end.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the reception desk. The receptionist lifts her gaze and gives the arriving guests one calm, reassuring nod; the guests remain relaxed with their travel document visible. End with the welcoming nod held naturally.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second version, use a single calm acknowledgment: the receptionist raises her attention to the guests, then completes a gentle nod over most of the shot. Keep the travelers composed and their document readable as an object, with a fixed camera centered on the reception exchange. The endpoint is the receptionist’s completed welcoming nod.
models.positive_prompt: At the reception desk, the receptionist looks up and gives the guests a gentle reassuring nod while they wait calmly with their document. Fixed camera; finish on the acknowledged, welcoming check-in moment.

models.scene_plan: In four seconds, focus tightly on one brief reassurance at the desk: the receptionist shifts her gaze toward the guests and completes a small, composed nod. The guests remain settled beside their luggage, with the travel document retained at the counter. Fixed camera; finish as the welcoming acknowledgment is clearly visible.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed shot of the reception. The receptionist looks up and gives the waiting guests a small reassuring nod; they stay calm with the travel document at the counter. End on a clear welcoming acknowledgment.
